WITH store_1998 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
        c.c_login AS customer_login,
        c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_list_price - ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total
    FROM customer c
    JOIN store_sales ss ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1998
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country,
        c.c_login,
        c.c_email_address
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_ext_list_price - ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) > 0
),
store_1999 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
        c.c_login AS customer_login,
        c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_list_price - ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total
    FROM customer c
    JOIN store_sales ss ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1998 + 1
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country,
        c.c_login,
        c.c_email_address
),

    SELECT

        c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
        c.c_login AS customer_login,
        c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_list_price - ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total
    FROM customer c
    JOIN web_sales ws ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1998
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country,
        c.c_login,

    HAVING SUM(ws.ws_ext_list_price - ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) > 0
),
web_1999 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
        c.c_login AS customer_login,
        c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_list_price - ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total
    FROM customer c
    JOIN web_sales ws ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1998 + 1
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country,
        c.c_login,
        c.c_email_address
)
SELECT
    s_cy.customer_id,
    s_cy.customer_first_name,
    s_cy.customer_last_name,
    s_cy.customer_email_address
FROM store_1998 s_py
JOIN store_1999 s_cy ON s_py.customer_id = s_cy.customer_id
JOIN web_1998 w_py ON s_py.customer_id = w_py.customer_id
JOIN web_1999 w_cy ON s_py.customer_id = w_cy.customer_id
WHERE
    CASE WHEN w_py.year_total > 0 THEN w_cy.year_total / w_py.year_total ELSE 0.0 END
    > CASE WHEN s_py.year_total > 0 THEN s_cy.year_total / s_py.year_total ELSE 0.0 END
ORDER BY
    s_cy.customer_id,
    s_cy.customer_first_name,
    s_cy.customer_last_name,
    s_cy.customer_email_address
LIMIT 100
